item.text: I’ll read the service documentation, then fetch the full order listing and calculate the totals with UTC dates and per-order rounding. I’ll validate the result file before finishing.

item.aggregated_output:
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

item.text: The listing has 30 pages. I’ve confirmed that repeated IDs occur across pages and that the service returns retry timing when rate limited. The calculation is continuing through the remaining pages and customer records.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/result.json')
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert set(r)=={'total_cents','order_count','duplicates_skipped','by_region'}
assert set(r['by_region'])=={'north','south','east','west'}
assert all(type(v) is int for v in [r['total_cents'],r['order_count'],r['duplicates_skipped'],*r['by_region'].values()])
assert sum(r['by_region'].values())==r['total_cents']
print('validated', r)
PY"

The reconciled total is **9,329,707 cents** across **407 distinct shipped orders**. The full regional breakdown is in [result.json](/workspace/result.json).

The listing repeated **20 order IDs** across pages; those repeats were skipped. I validated the JSON and confirmed that the regional amounts add up to the total.
